_origin: Messages CallChannelBodyUnknownKindTest (audio-only calls S1, Iris §7.189 F1; design AUDIO_ONLY_CALLS_DESIGN_2026-11-19 §6 «The exact parse spec»; Java CallChannelBodyBean.parseChannelBody, Dart CallChannelBody.parse). `body` is the plaintext of a channel box as received (an open or a message). Strict JSON first (duplicate keys and a non-object refused); then an `h` that is a JSON string and not one of `known_kinds` (case-sensitive) is an UNKNOWN kind: only `h`, `epoch`, `conv_seed` are kept, every other member is dropped before any schema check; `epoch` must be a JSON integer within ±(2^53-1), `conv_seed` a JSON string, JSON null = absent. A known, absent or non-string `h` keeps the full strict schema. `expect.ok`: accepted or refused; a port must agree on `ok` and, when accepted, on every other member. `stage` is where THIS reference refuses (json | kept_member | schema), `error`/`reason` what HybridChannel.acceptChannel throws for such an open (key_refused / body). Accepted: `canonical` = JCS of the parsed body (for an unknown kind: of the kept members only), `plaintext_hex` = its ASCII, `known_kind` = h is a known kind, `ignored_kind` = h is a string and not a known kind (on an open: a non-handover open that still applies O-7 with `epoch` and §10.1 with `conv_seed`; on a message: ignored, no refusal), `declared_media` = CallChannelBodyBean.declaredMedia (null for any non-media kind).
